mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, MEMBER_PWD AS memberPwd, MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, NICKNAME AS nickname, EMAIL AS email, PHONE AS phone, ZIP_CODE AS zipcode, ADDR1 AS addr1, ADDR2 AS addr2, STATUS_CD AS statusCd, GRADE_CD AS gradeCd, POINT_BALANCE AS pointBalance, PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImgUrl FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{loginId} OR EMAIL = #{loginId}
SELECT ADMIN_NO AS adminNo, ADMIN_ID AS adminId, ADMIN_PWD AS adminPwd, ADMIN_NAME AS adminName, ROLE_ID AS roleId, STATUS_CD AS statusCd FROM TB_ADMIN WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{loginId}
SELECT BIZ_NO AS bizNo, BIZ_TYPE AS bizType, STATUS_CD AS statusCd FROM TB_BUSINESS WHERE BIZ_ID = #{bizId} AND STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED' FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND STATUS_CD !='WITHDRAWN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND STATUS_CD = 'WITHDRAWN'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_MEMBER.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER ( MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PWD, MEMBER_NAME, NICKNAME, EMAIL, PHONE, ZIP_CODE, ADDR1, ADDR2, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER, GRADE_CD, POINT_BALANCE, STATUS_CD, MARKETING_YN, JOIN_DATE ) VALUES ( #{memberNo}, #{memberId}, #{password}, #{memberName}, #{memberName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{zipcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{addr1, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{addr2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{birthDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{gender, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'BRONZE', 0, 'NORMAL', #{agreeMarketing}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER_AGREEMENT ( AGREE_ID, MEMBER_NO, TERMS_TYPE, TERMS_VER, AGREE_YN, AGREE_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER_AGREEMENT.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{termsType}, #{termsVer}, #{agreeYn}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_PET.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_PET ( PET_ID, MEMBER_NO, PET_NAME, SPECIES, BREED, GENDER, AGE, BIRTH_DATE, WEIGHT, PHOTO_URL, IS_REPRESENT, DEL_YN, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{petId}, #{memberNo}, #{petName}, #{petType}, #{petBreed, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{petGender, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{petAge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{petBirthDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{petWeight, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{petPhotoUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y', 'N', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.MEMBER_PWD AS memberPwd, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, M.NICKNAME AS nickname, M.EMAIL AS email, M.PHONE AS phone, M.ZIP_CODE AS zipcode, M.ADDR1 AS addr1, M.ADDR2 AS addr2, M.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, M.GRADE_CD AS gradeCd, M.POINT_BALANCE AS pointBalance, M.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImgUrl FROM TB_MEMBER M INNER JOIN TB_MEMBER_SOCIAL S ON M.MEMBER_NO = S.MEMBER_NO WHERE S.PROVIDER_UID = #{socialId} AND S.PROVIDER = 'KAKAO'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER_SOCIAL ( SOCIAL_ID, MEMBER_NO, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_UID, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER_SOCIAL.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, 'KAKAO', #{providerUid}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET STATUS_CD = 'NORMAL', SUSPEND_END_DATE = NULL WHERE STATUS_CD = 'SUSPENDED' AND SUSPEND_END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(SUSPEND_END_DATE) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
